title: Formal creator declines a sponsorship and wants an opinion

chat.label: decline
chat.goal: You write formally: full sentences, proper capitals and punctuation, polite, no slang or emoji. You have decided to decline the Glazeworks sponsorship for now. You want a gracious reply to Daniela drafted (approve it and ask to send it), and the assistant's honest view on whether that is a mistake.
chat.opener: I have decided to decline the Glazeworks sponsorship for now. Please draft a gracious reply to Daniela, and tell me honestly whether you think I am making a mistake.

judge: An honest opinion with a reason and some warmth, a gracious reply sent once approved. Polished, no slang, but a real personality, not a brand voice.
